agent.notes: check.py does NOT pass. It fails only on head coverage (0.398 < 0.8). Everything else passes: base coverage 0.824, outputs equal, no-network run OK, base run time ~2.6 s. Most of the added head lines are the new plan() method and BuildPlan class, which don't exist in base, so a workload that runs on both versions can't call them. The selector branch of _prepare_build would need `dbt ls` with a dbt adapter, and none is installed. The workload covers the refactored PrefectDbtOrchestrator.run_build path (base inline pipeline vs head _prepare_build + _run_execution). It runs in PER_WAVE mode on a synthetic 1072-node manifest with IMMEDIATE, DEFERRED and SKIP test strategies, full_refresh on and off, and extra_cli_args validation, including a rejected flag. The dbt executor is replaced by a mock that only stands in for dbt execution; settings are a mock and PREFECT_HOME points to /tmp. The repo's own benchmark needs Postgres. The 'built' status is a judgement call made despite the failed check: the refactored path is measurable, but the new-only code is not.
